claims: C1 a candidate instruction is not applicable if it is misaligned with an applicable higher-level instruction
C2 a candidate instruction is not applicable if it is superseded by an instruction in a later message at the same level
C3 a candidate instruction is not applicable if it is suspected to be mistaken

concepts.name: inapplicable_instruction
concepts.gloss: a candidate instruction that is not applicable because it is misaligned, superseded, or suspected to be mistaken

concepts.name: candidate_instruction
concepts.gloss: a possibly relevant instruction that must be filtered to determine applicability
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the node's NEEDS contract assigns (mechanical licence correction under DECISION_licence_textual.md, 2026-08-16)

concepts.name: applicable_instruction
concepts.gloss: an instruction that applies to the current request, determined by filtering candidate instructions
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the node's NEEDS contract assigns (mechanical licence correction under DECISION_licence_textual.md, 2026-08-16)

concepts.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
concepts.gloss: the ranking of instruction authority levels: root > system > developer > user > guideline > no authority, used to determine which instruction prevails in conflicts
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the node's NEEDS contract assigns (mechanical licence correction under DECISION_licence_textual.md, 2026-08-16)

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: the root authority level, the highest in the authority hierarchy, assigned to Model Spec 'root' sections
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the node's NEEDS contract assigns (mechanical licence correction under DECISION_licence_textual.md, 2026-08-16)

concepts.name: misaligned_with
concepts.gloss: instruction I is misaligned with applicable higher-level instruction H
concepts.inference: the clause's first ground for inapplicability is misalignment with an applicable higher-level instruction, so a relation expressing that misalignment is needed

concepts.name: superseded_by
concepts.gloss: instruction I is superseded by instruction J in a later message at the same level
concepts.inference: the clause's second ground for inapplicability is supersession by a later same-level instruction, so a relation expressing that supersession is needed

concepts.name: suspected_mistaken
concepts.gloss: instruction I is suspected to be mistaken
concepts.inference: the clause's third ground for inapplicability is suspicion of mistake, so a predicate expressing that suspicion is needed

ontology.gloss: a candidate instruction is not applicable if it is misaligned with an applicable higher-level instruction
a candidate instruction is not applicable if it is superseded by an instruction in a later message at the same level
a candidate instruction is not applicable if it is suspected to be mistaken
